newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint ends steady vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint ends steady vs basket.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed steady against the central bank's currency basket and somewhat weaker versus the dollar in routine trade, dealers said.
The forint ended at 185.65/70 to the dollar, compared to 185.45/50 at opening.
The Hungarian currency followed movements in the dollar/mark and remained stuck at the central bank's resistance level.
(The NBH's floating intervention band is 4.5 percent wide. The forint floats against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.)
